claims.text: Padding hidden in each task tends to get used by that task (people plan to the time given) and rarely reaches a task that really runs late: nobody sees it and it is usually used up. One shared visible buffer shows how much is consumed.

A buffer covers the uncertainty of the planned work; new work is not taken from it but changes the plan through the product owner. If the buffer runs down faster than the work moves, the team raises the plan with the product owner.
Measuring from M, not O, makes the buffer room for running later than the most likely value; the widest gap adds most; in the refund plan both P − M gaps are 8, so each item adds 4 days.
